scope: Theorem 4.1 (Bounded-dominion guarantee) of the manuscript “Mean-payoff parity games in quasipolynomial time” (preprints/Mean-payoff-parity-games-in-quasipolynomial-time-October-5-2026/mean-payoff-parity.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 104 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 78583f3170d29154), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every subarena H of the original game and every b ∈ {0, . . . , n}2, the procedure Solve(H, b) terminates and returns a partition satisfying (4) for both players.
